title: An integrated techno-economic analysis and life cycle assessment of lube oil production from post-use polypropylene and comparison with conventional base oils
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00910C, Paper

Sultana Ferdous, Ulises R. Gracida-Alvarez, Pahola Thathiana Benavides, Meltem Urgun-Demirtas
This study presents an integrated analysis of the technical, economic, and environmental performance of upcycling post-use polypropylene (PU-PP) through hydrogenolysis, using a platinum strontium titanate (Pt/SrTiO3) catalyst.
